scientific_integrity: The known exact Gaussian contractivity criterion is credited, not presented as novel. Finite checker results are supportive only. No external expert or independent mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: This is not a nonnormal or correlated Gaussian drift theorem; the rational small-time expansion is not uniform in denominator; the contact law is liminf only; the vertical-window limit precedes the small-real-time limit.
scientific_scope: Complex Gaussian Lp on two independent coordinates, 1<p<infinity, p != 2, two positive relaxation rates; imaginary-time boundedness geometry and arithmetic rate-ratio effects.
title: Arithmetic contact and density laws for two-rate Gaussian semigroups
